MapNotes.GMOnly: Only a GM can place Irovetti's map notes.
MapNotes.NoPack: The Points of Interest journal pack is missing. Run npm run build.
MapNotes.WrongScene: {scene} is not the Kingmaker Stolen Lands map (275 px hex rows), so Irovetti's map notes can't go there.
MapNotes.NoScene: This world has no Kingmaker Stolen Lands map (275 px hex rows). Import it from the Kingmaker module, then place Irovetti's map notes.
MapNotes.ManyScenes: This world has {count} Kingmaker Stolen Lands maps. View the one to mark, then place Irovetti's map notes.
MapNotes.Placed: Placed {count} of Irovetti's map notes on {scene}.
MapNotes.Merged: Moved Irovetti's sites into the {journal} journal and deleted the {count} entries it replaces.
MapNotes.SceneNotes: Added a journal note to {count} of the Points of Interest scenes.

SceneLinks.Missing: This scene is missing from the Points of Interest scenes pack. Run npm run build.
